_note: Causes everywhere (GDD 4.10 decision 2, 'L2b's questions', session L2b): the words of the week report (the planner's left column and 'Last week in full'), the taps on the body bars, the moods and the people. WeekCauses (scripts/core/week_causes.gd) reads only what the game recorded (WeekSim's stimulus by source, HealthSystem.strain_log, MindSystem.drift, a person's relationship log, the day log's life_parts) and never states a cause it did not record. `people_does` and `trust_does` say only what a relationship really does in the game today: tools/causes_check.gd checks each `people_does` range against the storylets' relation conditions (P2 gives people more).

small._note: Two levels (L2b decision 2): a change is shown when it reads at least 0.01 (two decimals); the planner's list shows it only when it reads at least 0.1 with one decimal (|change| >= main).

attr.not_recorded: Where it came from was not recorded (a save from before this version).

body.not_used: more load than your body is used to (×{x})
body.used_to: used to this load (×{x}, less strain)
body.none_yet: Recorded from now on: the next days show what raised it.
body.tired_helps: Rest days and easy days bring it down; heavy school days and late nights slow the recovery.

mood.no_pulls: nothing pulling it: back towards the middle

people.trust_drift: {arrow} {delta} · Sunday · drifts towards how well you fit ({fit})

people_does._note: What a relationship's level really does today (only effects the game simulates; checked by tools/causes_check.gd against the storylets' `relation` conditions: role = the storylet's `from`, below / from = the condition's limits). A person with no entry gets no 'does' line until P2.

best_friend.text: may feel left out and say so
tells you what's on their mind

trust_does._note: What trust really does (data/mind.json news.trust_factor, drift.motivation.trust, drift.stress.strained).
trust_does.new: {his} words land a little softer while you get to know each other
trust_does.strong: {his} words lift you more · motivation pulled up
trust_does.strained: {his} words land softer · motivation pulled down, stress up

tests.title: {subject} test
tests.detail: {subject}: recent tests {list} · the report card would give {grade} now. Grades count towards the application average after grade 9.

slots.study_load: Each school day carried +{n} life load from the extra studying.
slots.early_detail: A rest evening makes the next school day lighter: {list}.

mental._note: Session L3b1: the week's mental sessions as one row (WeekCauses.mental_rows), only what was recorded: each kind's composure part, relaxation's / self-talk's pull in Sunday's drift, the halved nerves, the school days' life load.
mental.title: Mental training
mental.again: A second {name} ({days}) added nothing: each kind counts once a week.
mental.load: A little more on {n} school days (+{each} life load each).

report.title: LAST WEEK IN FULL
report.none_this_week: No days played yet this week.
report.no_attrs: No attribute moved enough to show (changes under 0.01). Progress builds up slowly.
